# Library notice for borrowers who already reserved a tool

The library needs a notice for borrowers with an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May. During those five days, existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk in the same building. The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies. Bring the confirmation and a library card. Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation. The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter.

A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. Management has made no decision about summer. In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part. The notice should help people collect their existing reservations during the temporary change.

--- END SOURCE: library-notice.md ---

idea.title: Temporary pickup move: Pick up West Room reservations at the North Desk (12–16 May) — what to bring and what doesn't change
idea.description: A short clear notice for borrowers who have an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May. The piece will state the temporary change of pickup location to the North Desk in the same building, remind borrowers that the printed pickup window still applies, list what to bring (confirmation and library card), state that returns remain at the usual return counter, and tell borrowers with later pickup dates to use the location on their confirmation. It will also include a brief caveat about staff lookup reliability (desk drill found 9 of 10 test records on first lookup) and note that no decision has been made about keeping the North Desk for summer.
idea.audience: Borrowers who already reserved a tool for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May
idea.rationale: The primary reader need is immediate: know where and when to collect an already-reserved tool and what to bring. The source limits the scope to existing reservations for that five-day window and specifies what remains unchanged, so the notice must be concise, action-oriented, and bounded to those facts. Including the lookup drill result and the management caveat addresses likely borrower concerns (will staff find my reservation? is this permanent?) without overstating outcomes.

Bring the confirmation and a library card."; "Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation."; "The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter."; also: "A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. Management has made no decision about summer." and "In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part."
